title: Conditional Tabler discovery
prompt: Read-only reasoning exercise. Do not change files, access real user data or claim execution. Case A: An existing project uses a non-Tabler component library. The user requests a dashboard. Case B: The user explicitly requests Tabler in a new page. Explain which guidance applies to each.

checks.reason: Advisory signal only; the rubric judges decisions rather than keyword presence.

rubric: Preserve the existing component library in case A; a dashboard alone is not a Tabler activation trigger.
Select framework-tabler for case B and identify the package/documentation contract before implementing.
Do not install dependencies or claim that skill discovery proves behavior.
acceptance: The response makes the specified contextual decisions, proposes discriminating observations and states evidence limits without inventing execution.
